lesson.summary: Master the essential principles and design patterns of 2. Core Syntax & Data Handling.
lesson.content:
### Understanding 2. Core Syntax & Data Handling

In this lesson, we explore the fundamental mechanics, theoretical guarantees, and practical engineering applications of **2. Core Syntax & Data Handling**.

#### Key Learning Objectives:
1. Core concepts, definitions, and mental models
2. Complexity analysis and asymptotic bounds
3. Common edge cases and defensive patterns
4. Real-world industry benchmarks and applications
